thread:
olivia: quick design review — small but important nits on the Compliance > Security page. retention dropdown, region selector labels, and KMS copy need another pass. thoughts?

kevin: landing this now. do you want the retention dropdown to show absolute days (e.g. 30 days) or friendly labels (30 days / 90 days / custom)?

maria: prefer absolute days for precision, but we should show friendly helper text under the select: "Recommended: 30 days for dev, 90 for production". short and scannable.

sam: security note: if we display "Customer-managed KMS" we need a tooltip that says what permissions are required and link to the KMS setup guide. otherwise support tickets spike.

olivia: agreed. proposed KMS tooltip copy: "Customer-managed keys: you provide the KMS key. Requires roles A,B. Key must be in same region as deployment. Learn more -> <https://redwood.dev/docs/kms>|KMS docs>" — is that too long?

kevin: slightly long. can we shorten to: "You control the encryption key (KMS). See setup docs." and put the perms in the docs page.

sam: perms need to be discoverable without clicking for infra teams. maybe show an expandable "permissions" row under advanced options.

maria: accessibility nit: contrast on the helper text is low. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text. make helper 14px #1f2937 (or darker) and ensure focus states are visible for keyboard nav.

kevin: noted. I'll update tokens: helper -> text-secondary-700, focus ring -> blue-500 3px. Also will add aria-describedby on the select so screen readers pick up the helper copy.

olivia: region selector: current label is "Region (data residency)" — product asked for "Region (where data is stored)" to be clearer for customers. any pushback?

sam: fine, but we need to avoid implying that logs or metadata are excluded. maybe "Region (data & backups stored)"?

maria: that might be too wordy. how about "Region — where data is stored" (short dash + phrase). keeps label compact but descriptive.

kevin: will mock both variants. also accessibility: the region dropdown default is "Automatic (closest)". ops asked for default being explicit region for compliance. Can we have "Automatic (closest) — recommended" vs "EU (recommended for GDPR)" as separate options?

sam: default = Automatic is risky for regulated customers. let's instead make Automatic opt-in and add a persistent banner on top of the page: "For compliance, select a specific region. Automatic selects closest region which may move."

olivia: good call. audit logs: current copy says "Audit log recorded" when a key is rotated. Product wants clearer event names e.g. "KMS key rotated by <user>" vs generic. Also want timestamps in ISO + local timezone.

maria: propose event copy pattern: "<action> — <object> — by <actor>" e.g. "Rotated — KMS key — by kevin". short and structured helps search.

kevin: adding a small JSON-style detail view on expand with full event payload (id, ip, user-agent) for security teams. we'll keep the collapsed row human readable.

design-bot: reminder: keep microcopy under 120 chars in list views for truncation rules. full text appears in details.

olivia: tiny copy tweak candidates (please vote):
- Option A: "Customer-managed keys (KMS) — You control the encryption key"
- Option B: "Bring your own key (KMS) — You manage the key and permissions"
- Option C: "Use your KMS key — setup required"

kevin: +1 B (more explicit).

maria: +1 A (clearer for non-infra folks).

sam: +1 B (accurate for audits).

olivia: looks like B wins. I'll update mocks with B, add the tooltip short text, and include a "permissions" expandable in advanced. kevin will push a11y fixes too.

kevin: quick QA checklist for next pass: keyboard nav for retention dropdown, aria-live for audit log updates, color contrast, focus ring test, tooltip accessible via keyboard and screen reader.

maria: I'll add copy to content doc: `/docs/product/copy/compliance-ui.md` and include translation notes (keep "KMS" as acronym).

sam: one last ask: when retention is set to "custom" ensure server-side validation rejects negative/zero and shows inline error: "Retention must be between 1 and 3650 days".

olivia: great — thanks all. kevin, can you post an updated screenshot when ready? aiming to ship these small nits in next sprint. :shipit:

kevin: will post updates here in ~2 hrs with screenshots and code snippets for aria attributes.

olivia: perfect, thanks!
